content_of_post_to_answer: What is one skill that can make a person more confident in almost every area of life?
answer: The skill that changes confidence everywhere is not speaking louder or knowing more; it is the ability to trust yourself after making decisions. Confidence grows from evidence that you can handle uncertainty, correct mistakes, and recover when things go wrong. I've explored this pattern more deeply on my profile for those interested in the psychology behind it. The most confident people are not those who never doubt themselves, but those who know doubt does not control their actions.
